select * from (
SELECT channel.*,string_agg(ssubscribeNumUserAccess.user_id::text, ',') as subscribeUserIds,
CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(1) FROM gc_user_access_permission per LEFT JOIN gc_user_access acc ON acc.id = per.user_access_id WHERE per.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and acc.user_id = #{userId} and acc.master_id=#{masterId} GROUP BY acc.user_id ) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS followFlag
info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, tags.id AS tag_id, tags.channel_id AS tag_channel_id, tags.type AS tag_type, tags.tag_text AS tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') AS channelTags FROM pt_channel channel LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe sub on channel.id = sub.channel_id AND sub.is_deleted = false left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission permission ON permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access userAccess on userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission accessPermission ON accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = accessPermission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission subscribeNumPermission ON subscribeNumPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ssubscribeNumUserAccess on ssubscribeNumUserAccess.id = subscribeNumPermission.user_access_id WHERE 1 = 1 and level=0
and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id =#{masterId} and permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) or ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} and channel.level=0 and channel.master_id = #{masterId})
and access.user_id = #{userId} and access.master_id=#{masterId} and (accessPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) = false or accessPermission.subscribe_permission is null) and accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and ( channel.create_user_id !=#{userId} and channel.level=0 ) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}
GROUP BY channel.id order by channel.create_time desc
) as channels where channels.followFlag=0 order by channels.create_time desc

SELECT channel.*, COALESCE((select count(ua.id) from gc_access access LEFT JOIN content_group_channel_subscription cgcs on cgcs.content_group_id=access.id AND cgcs.channel_id=channel.id AND is_subscribed=true ),0) as subscribeNum,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName,tags.id as tag_id,tags.channel_id as tag_channel_id,tags.type as tag_type,tags.tag_text as tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') as channelTags FROM pt_channel channel left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id left join gc_user_access_permission permission on permission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_access access on access.id = ua.access_id where access.id=#{accessId} and ua.master_id=#{masterId} group by channel.id,info.last_name,info.first_name,tags.id,tags.channel_id,tags.type,tags.tag_text

select ch.*, u.username as channel_create_user_username,u.id as channel_create_uid,info.last_name as createUserLastName, info.first_name as createUserFirstName,tags.id as tag_id,tags.channel_id as tag_channel_id,tags.type as tag_type,tags.tag_text as tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') as channelTags, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id from pt_channel ch left join gc_user u on u.id = ch.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = u.info_id left join sys_file file on file.id = info.avatar_file_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = ch.id
where 1=1 and ch.id in
#{channelId}
where 1=2
and ch.channel_name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
group by ch.id, u.id, info.id, tags.id

select * from (
select * from (
SELECT channel.*,string_agg(ssubscribeNumUserAccess.user_id::text, ',') as subscribeUserIds,
CASE WHEN ( SELECT count(1) FROM gc_user_access_permission per LEFT JOIN gc_user_access acc ON acc.id = per.user_access_id WHERE per.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and acc.user_id = #{userId} and acc.master_id=#{masterId} GROUP BY acc.user_id ) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS followFlag,
info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, tags.id AS tag_id, tags.channel_id AS tag_channel_id, tags.type AS tag_type, tags.tag_text AS tag_text, string_agg(tags.tag_text, ',') AS channelTags FROM pt_channel channel LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe sub on channel.id = sub.channel_id AND sub.is_deleted = false left join gc_user us on us.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us.info_id left join pt_tags tags on tags.channel_id = channel.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission permission ON permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access userAccess on userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission accessPermission ON accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access on access.id = accessPermission.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission subscribeNumPermission ON subscribeNumPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ssubscribeNumUserAccess on ssubscribeNumUserAccess.id = subscribeNumPermission.user_access_id WHERE((accessPermission.id is not null) or (subscribeNumPermission.id is not null)) and (userAccess.user_id = #{userId} or access.user_id = #{userId}) and level=0
and userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id =#{masterId} and permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) or ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} and channel.level=0 and channel.master_id = #{masterId})
and access.user_id = #{userId} and access.master_id=#{masterId} and (accessPermission.subscribe_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) = false or accessPermission.subscribe_permission is null ) and accessPermission.channel_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(channel.id::integer) and ( channel.create_user_id !=#{userId} and channel.level=0 ) and channel.master_id = #{masterId}
GROUP BY channel.id order by channel.create_time desc
) as channels where channels.followFlag=0 order by channels.create_time desc
) as chs where 1=1
and concat(chs.channel_name,chs.channel_slug) like concat('%',#{searchName},'%')

select channel.channel_img_file_id,channel."desc",channel.create_user_id,channel.visible_flag,channel.category_id, channel.level,channel.fid,channel."order",channel.master_id,coalesce(channel.channel_slug,ch2.channel_slug) as channel_slug,channel.create_time, channel.update_time,channel.channel_avatar_file_id, coalesce(ch2.id,channel.id) as id, coalesce(ch2.channel_name,channel.channel_name) as channel_name, video_content.id as video_id, video_content.file_id as fileId, info.last_name AS createUserLastName, info.first_name AS createUserFirstName, info.avatar_file_id as userInfo_avatar_file_id, us2.id as channel_create_uid, count(vac.id) as likeNum, case when vac.user_id=#{userId} then 1 else 0 end as isLiked, pcc.id as channelContentId from gc_video video_content left join pt_channel_content pcc on video_content.id = pcc.content_id left join pt_channel channel on pcc.channel_id = channel.id left join pt_channel ch2 on ch2.id = channel.fid left join gc_user_access_permission permission ON (permission.subscribe_permission::jsonb || permission.channel_permission::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(coalesce(ch2.id,channel.id)::integer) left join gc_user_access userAccess ON userAccess.id = permission.user_access_id left join gc_user us on us.id = userAccess.user_id left join gc_user us2 on us2.id = channel.create_user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = us2.info_id left join gc_user_video_action vac on vac.content_id = video_content.id and vac."type" = 1 where userAccess.user_id = #{userId} and us.id = #{userId} and userAccess.master_id = #{masterId} OR ( channel.create_user_id =#{userId} AND channel.master_id = #{masterId} ) and pcc.id is not null
and video_content.video_name like concat('%',#{searchName},'%')
GROUP BY video_content.id, channel.id, ch2.id, info.id, us2.id, vac.id, pcc.id order by video_content.update_time desc

SELECT time_bucket, COUNT(pc.id) OVER (ORDER BY time_bucket) AS value FROM pt_channel pc RIGHT JOIN generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval) AS time_bucket ON pc.create_time >= time_bucket AND pc.create_time < time_bucket + concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval AND pc.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY time_bucket, pc.id ORDER BY time_bucket;

SELECT time_bucket, COUNT(pc.id) AS value FROM pt_channel pc RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT #{filter.start}::timestamp with time zone AS time_bucket UNION SELECT #{filter.end}::timestamp with time zone ) AS time_bucket ON pc.create_time <= time_bucket AND pc.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket;

SELECT pc.*, sf_avatar.file_url as owner_avatar_url, gu.id as channel_create_uid, gui.first_name as userInfo_firstName, gui.last_name as userInfo_lastName, sf_pc_avatar.file_url as avatar_full_file_url, sf_img.file_url as img_full_file_url, count(pcs.id) as subscribeNum FROM pt_channel pc JOIN gc_user gu ON pc.create_user_id = gu.id JOIN gc_user_info gui ON gu.info_id = gui.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_avatar ON gui.avatar_file_id = sf_avatar.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_pc_avatar ON pc.channel_avatar_file_id = sf_pc_avatar.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_img ON pc.channel_img_file_id = sf_img.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe pcs ON pc.id = pcs.channel_id AND pcs.is_deleted = false WHERE pc.level = 0 AND pc.create_user_id = #{userId} AND pc.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY pc.id, gu.id, gui.id, sf_avatar.id, sf_img.id, sf_pc_avatar.id ORDER BY pc.update_time DESC;

SELECT pc.*, sf_avatar.file_url as owner_avatar_url, gu.id as channel_create_uid, gui.first_name as userInfo_firstName, gui.last_name as userInfo_lastName, sf_pc_avatar.file_url as avatar_full_file_url, sf_img.file_url as img_full_file_url, pcs.update_time as subscription_time, count(subscribe_pcs.id) as subscribeNum FROM pt_channel_subscribe pcs JOIN pt_channel pc ON pc.id = pcs.channel_id AND pc.master_id = #{masterId} AND pc.visible_flag != 0 JOIN gc_user gu ON pc.create_user_id = gu.id JOIN gc_user_info gui ON gu.info_id = gui.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_avatar ON gui.avatar_file_id = sf_avatar.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_pc_avatar ON pc.channel_avatar_file_id = sf_pc_avatar.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_img ON pc.channel_img_file_id = sf_img.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe subscribe_pcs ON pc.id = subscribe_pcs.channel_id AND subscribe_pcs.is_deleted = false WHERE pcs.is_deleted = false AND pcs.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY pc.id, pcs.id, gu.id, gui.id, sf_avatar.id, sf_img.id, sf_pc_avatar.id ORDER BY pcs.update_time DESC;

SELECT pc.*, sf_avatar.file_url as owner_avatar_url, gu.id as channel_create_uid, gui.first_name as userInfo_firstName, gui.last_name as userInfo_lastName, sf_pc_avatar.file_url as avatar_full_file_url, sf_img.file_url as img_full_file_url, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM pt_channel_subscribe WHERE channel_id = pc.id AND is_deleted = false) as subscribeNum FROM pt_channel pc LEFT JOIN content_group_channel_subscription cgc on cgc.channel_id = pc.id AND cgc.is_subscribed = false AND cgc.created_by_user_id != #{userId} LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua on ua.access_id = cgc.content_group_id AND ua.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe pcs on pc.id = pcs.channel_id AND pcs.is_deleted = true AND pcs.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN pt_channel_subscribe pcs_subscribed on pc.id = pcs_subscribed.channel_id AND pcs_subscribed.is_deleted = false AND pcs_subscribed.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN gc_user gu ON pc.create_user_id = gu.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info gui ON gu.info_id = gui.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_avatar ON gui.avatar_file_id = sf_avatar.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_pc_avatar ON pc.channel_avatar_file_id = sf_pc_avatar.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sf_img ON pc.channel_img_file_id = sf_img.id WHERE pc.master_id = #{masterId} AND pc.level = 0 AND ((pc.create_user_id = #{userId} OR pc.visible_flag = 1) AND pcs_subscribed.id IS NULL OR pc.visible_flag = 2 AND (ua.id IS NOT NULL OR pcs.id IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY cgc.modified_date DESC
